description: A shell script containing tests for git fetch negotiation, including skipping fetch negotiator, ref filtering, clock skew handling, and protocol version testing.

methods.name: have_sent
methods.description: Checks if specific commits have been sent during fetch by grepping trace output.

methods.name: have_not_sent
methods.description: Checks if specific commits have not been sent during fetch.

methods.name: trace_fetch
methods.description: Runs a git fetch command with trace output, disabling GIT_TRACE_PACKET in the child process.
